name: notification_mark_read
_assertDoc: notifications._id=${NOTIFICATION_ID}: readByReceiver contains ${USER_ID}. NOTE Node has no idempotency guard — a repeat call pushes the id again (duplicate). Response returns the PRE-update doc.

name: notification_mark_all_read
_assertDoc: every notifications doc receiverId=${USER_ID} (or adminReceiverId contains it) now has ${USER_ID} in readByReceiver ($addToSet — idempotent).

name: explore_action_like
_assertDoc: explores._id=${EXPLORE_ID}: likes toggles a {userId:${USER_ID}} subdoc. Run twice → back to original (idempotent toggle). actionType=notRecommand writes the misspelled field 'notRecommed'.

name: live_like
_assertDoc: broadcasts._id=${BROADCAST_ID}: likes toggles ${USER_ID}. On like (not unlike) a comments doc {broadcastId,userId,comment:'<name> liked event'} is inserted.

name: follow_toggle
_assertDoc: type=FOLLOW: follows{userId,consultantId} toggles status; user_cons_rels.isUserFollowed mirrors it; response.count = follows.countDocuments({...,status:true}). type=FOLLOWLIST is intentionally NOT ported (throws FOLLOWLIST_NOT_PORTED).

name: user_update
_note: multer route: multipart/form-data with reqData field (+ optional profileImage file).
_assertDoc: users._id=${USER_ID}: name/details.* set from input (only when truthy AND not literal 'null'); details = {...oldDetails, ...newDetails}; registrationComplete=true iff all required fields present; streak increments. Response is the updated user (findOneAndUpdate {new:true}).

name: support_initiate_query
_note: Side effects: calls chat-server POST /chats/create-thread-support (ChatServerClient, trust-all TLS like Node rejectUnauthorized:false); FCM push is a seam.
_assertDoc: customer_support_queries: 1 new doc with ticketNumber '#QUERY_<n+1>' + threadId set; notificationns: 2 new docs (user receipt + admin system). Dedup: second identical call throws 'Query is already exist in pending state'.

name: support_chat_send
_note: multer route (reqData field + optional file). User path only (isByAdmin=false).
_assertDoc: customer_support_chats: 1 new doc with senderType=queryExist.userType; media set iff file uploaded; repliedMessage JSON-parsed. NODE BUG preserved: userId/consultantId are NOT set (Node referenced the model, not the user). Errors: 'Query does not exist' / 'Query is already resolved'.
